documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Financial Results For Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting

analysis.summary: Sportking India Limited reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting strong revenue and profit growth alongside capacity expansions. Management announced a greenfield capacity addition of 1.50 lakh spindles in Odisha with an outlay of approximately INR 1,000 Crores. The company also pursued forward integration through proposed acquisitions of Marvel Dyers and Processors and Sobhagia Sales. Furthermore, a 40.3 MW solar power plant was commissioned to reduce power costs. Sportking India Limited reported a strong start to FY27 with healthy revenue growth and significantly improved profitability driven by better yarn realizations, strong export demand, and disciplined raw material procurement.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue to reach around INR3,000 crores for the current fiscal year.
guidance.quote: So this year, last year, our top line was around INR2,500 crores. So this year, we are expecting somewhere around INR3,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Management targets revenue to grow to more than INR4,000 crores in the next financial year.
guidance.quote: And next year, with the new plant, we see this going up to around more than INR4,000 crores.

guidance.claim: The long-term normalized EBITDA margin guidance for the company post the Odisha plant is around 15%.
guidance.quote: So we give a long-term guidance of once a new project comes in a guidance of 15%, and we'll stick to that.

guidance.claim: Value-added products are expected to contribute around 10% to revenue in the next one year.
guidance.quote: But in next 1 year, we would say around 10%.

guidance.claim: Acquired downstream businesses are expected to contribute 8% to 10% to the top line from next year.
guidance.quote: But in the short-term, we expect these businesses to start contributing to the tune of 8% to 10% to our top line and anywhere close to the similar kind of EBITDA what we have in our bottom line from next year.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates the current quarter to be similar to or better than the previous quarter.
guidance.quote: But yes, the current quarter looks to be similar or even better than what we have delivered this last quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: India has a large working population which is an asset for the textile industry.
demand_outlook.quote: Large working population is an asset for this industry India has a large working population

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from all markets remained healthy, supported by the festive season and improving consumption trends domestically.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand from all the markets continued to remain healthy, and we are also encouraged by the outlook going into the second quarter. On the domestic front, we expect demand to remain supportive in the coming quarters, aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.

demand_outlook.claim: China has emerged as a big buyer for yarn exports, driving higher overall demand and price realizations.
demand_outlook.quote: So most of the incremental demand, which has come into India for yarn export is from China. Bangladesh continues to be steady as they were. And China, we continue to see every month, we see them as a buyer.

demand_outlook.claim: Global cotton yarn demand has improved due to supply chain realignment and sourcing diversification.
demand_outlook.quote: Another encouraging trend has been the improvement in global cotton yarn demand. Supply chain realignment, healthy export demand and increased sourcing diversification by international customers, which has supported the yarn realizations and profitability.

demand_outlook.claim: The company maintains an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days.
demand_outlook.quote: We have an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days in any year, whether it is this year or even the last year or whichever year because this is our policy we work to manage our risk of having higher inventory.

capex_expansion.claim: A solar power plant with a capacity of 40.3 MW was commissioned for supply of power to Bathinda and Ludhiana units.
capex_expansion.quote: The SPV has commissioned the Solar Power Plant with capacity of 40.3 MW for supply of power to Company`s Bathinda and Ludhiana Unit for period of 25 years.

capex_expansion.claim: The 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is progressing with construction underway.
capex_expansion.quote: Our 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is also progressing as planned. We are very excited with that. Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: Total announced capex for the Odisha project is approximately INR975 crores to INR1,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So ma'am, right now, what we have announced is about INR1000 crores, INR975 crores and which will be completed by the end of this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: Solar power projects have successfully commenced commercial operations to reduce power costs.
capex_expansion.quote: On the strategic front, I'm pleased to share that our solar power projects have successfully commenced commercial operations. This marks an important milestone in our journey towards sustainable and cost-efficient operations.

margins_costs.claim: Power cost is expected to be saved by about 12-15% in the long term from the solar power plant.
margins_costs.quote: Commenced commercial operations of power supply on 18th June 2026 and is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.

margins_costs.claim: Earnings growth during the quarter was driven by better yarn realizations, strong export demand, and disciplined raw material procurement.
margins_costs.quote: The quarter was particularly encouraging as the growth in earnings was driven by a combination of better yarn realizations, strong export demand and disciplined raw material procurement.

margins_costs.claim: The overall product spread was INR133 per kg during the quarter compared to INR107 per kg in the previous quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So the overall spread was INR133 vis-a-vis INR107 last quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The Odisha plant is expected to yield EBITDA margins 300 to 400 basis points higher than older plants due to embedded incentives.
margins_costs.quote: So about EBITDA accretion, this plant has many incentives which are embedded. So we expect the margins coming out of that plant to be at least 300 to 400 basis points or even more than what we do in our old plants.

orders_capacity.claim: The Odisha greenfield project is a 150,000-spindle expansion.
orders_capacity.quote: Our 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is also progressing as planned.

orders_capacity.claim: The company expects the Odisha plant to reach about 90% capacity utilization by the end of March.
orders_capacity.quote: And I think by March end, we should be at about 90% capacity utilization for the whole plant.

orders_capacity.claim: The company aims to reach 96% to 97% capacity utilization at the Odisha plant by the start of the next financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: Of course, that's our target that we want to reach 96%, 97% utilization by the start of the next financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: The proposed merger and acquisition of downstream businesses will predominantly involve preferential shares with a minor cash outflow.
capital_allocation.quote: So the merger will be predominantly preferential shares. So there will be a small outflow of cash. I think it will be less than maybe around INR25 crores, INR30 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The board approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited and manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited, along with the acquisition of manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited on a slump sale basis and land and building on lease basis, subject to the completion and execution of definitive agreements.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global cotton prices have shown some turbulence in recent months.
risks_headwinds.quote: While global cotton prices have shown some turbulence in recent months, we remain focused on prudent procurement and efficient inventory management.

management_commitments.claim: The proposed capex programme is planned to take 12-15 months to complete.
management_commitments.quote: Proposed capex programme to tak 12-15 months to complete

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to finish the entire Odisha project within the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We are very excited with that. Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to ramp up the entire Odisha plant within 5 to 6 months.
management_commitments.quote: And we expect to ramp up the whole plant. It's a big plant. So it will take us around 5 to 6 months to fully ramp up.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the Odisha plant to reach about 90% capacity utilization by the end of March.
management_commitments.quote: And I think by March end, we should be at about 90% capacity utilization for the whole plant.

management_commitments.claim: The cotton import duty resumption is currently set for 31st October.
management_commitments.quote: So right now, this import duty is the resumption is still 31st October.

management_commitments.claim: The full impact of the downstream acquisitions is expected to start coming in from next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Unfortunately, it's taking a little more time than what we envisaged, but I think it maybe take another 1 quarter, and we expect the full impact start coming, which will be around INR250 crores from next financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
